title: Doctor, Doctor!
synopsis: Kit teaches tracetoon doctor to say where the skill is installed and to recognize its own binary, after Glitch hides in a default parameter.
altText: Panel 1: Sam has just installed Tracetoon and asks where it went; Kit says the doctor should know. Panel 2: Kit checks the Claude, Codex and Antigravity folders and the binary's name. Panel 3: Glitch pops out of a test, cackling that undefined became the default. Panel 4: Kit passes null instead, the tests are green, and Sam cheers that the doctor knows everything now.

panels.scene: Sam has just run the one-command installer and looks puzzled

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: Installed! But where did it go?

panels.scene: Kit checks each agent's skills folder and the binary's name

dialogue.speaker: caption
dialogue.text: Claude, Codex, Antigravity: three folders, three versions.

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: And a binary that thinks it's Bun.

panels.scene: Glitch pops out of the new test

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.text: You passed undefined, so I became the default!

panels.scene: Kit fixes the test and everyone celebrates

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: Null means no Bun. All green!
